notes: Switching takeoff tabs is faster and no longer carries layer selections across. Please update.

fixes: Layers ticked in one takeoff no longer show as ticked in another after switching tabs. This mattered: the ticks are positional, so Delete or Copy-to-project could act on the wrong layers.
Switching between takeoff tabs no longer redraws the PDF every time - rendered sheets are kept and reused.
A tab holding layers but no PDF no longer describes itself as empty.
